01  Python in Unreal
UE05: Texture editor properties
WEEK 7  /  09G

import unreal
assets = unreal.EditorUtilityLibrary.get_selected_assets()
textures = [asset for asset in assets
            if isinstance(asset, unreal.Texture2D)]
print("Textures:", len(textures), "skipped:", len(assets) - len(textures))

for texture in textures:
    compression = texture.get_editor_property("compression_settings")
    srgb = texture.get_editor_property("srgb")
    print(texture.get_name(), compression, "sRGB:", srgb)
isinstance filters Texture2D inputs. get_editor_property reads the named setting; it does not change it.
